summary.short_summary: During the M&A Catch-Up meeting, discussions focused on enhancing the Instantly Platform and improving email management by planning to delete unused contacts and increasing outbound emails from 13,000 to 30,000 weekly. A decision was made to purchase 200 new email accounts for £200. Updates on lead generation included potential acquisitions, with emphasis on improving communication for the We Group while waiting for higher offers for Zen Media, which are expected to exceed 3 million. The slow progression of the TSG deal was also noted, alongside a review of various lead generation tools, leading to the decision to maintain the Clay subscription for $350/month for CRM enrichment. The team brainstormed strategies for targeting high net worth individuals, aiming to acquire 100 subscribers for a new subscription service at $500-600 per month.
